messages:
nora_csm: Heads up — Clearwell onboarding flagged. They have a 99.9% uptime SLO and p95 latency 250ms. Renewal in ~40 days and they asked for formal SLO reporting + the credit calc in contract. Previously saw spikes during initial data imports. Can we assemble a customer-facing runbook and one-page report for renewal?

aisha_cs: copying ops + eng. ok, priority medium-high. who can own the runbook and who will build the report template? :spiral_notepad:

ben_pm: I can draft the report template (metrics + incident history + credit calc). will need a dashboard link and the exact formula for credit buckets.

leah_eng: I can add a traced query and a p95 latency widget on the customer dashboard. also will add a prefix filter for their batch-import job so we can show pre/post-import deltas.

sam_ops: I’ll own the runbook and escalation path (oncall steps + rollback play). I’ll also wire up an automated weekly export to S3 that the CSM can send along. ETA: 3 business days.

nora_csm: thanks. Ben — for the credit formula in the contract it says "credits proportional to downtime beyond SLA, capped at 10%". We need concrete buckets for the report. Can ops/eng propose something we can present?

leah_eng: proposal: uptime SLO = 99.9%. Buckets: 99.8–99.9 => 1% credit, 99.5–99.8 => 3% credit, <99.5 => escalate for manual calc up to cap. For latency: if p95 > 250ms for >24h continuous, flag as degraded (informational, no automatic credit unless it causes request failures).

ben_pm: that bucketing looks reasonable. I'll draft the one-pager with that table and sample calculation. Example wording: "If measured monthly uptime = 99.67% (0.23% below 99.9) => falls in 99.5–99.8 bucket => 3% credit."

leah_eng: sample SQL for uptime calc (will add to runbook):
```
SELECT SUM(uptime_minutes)::float / SUM(total_minutes) * 100 AS uptime_pct
FROM customer_service_metrics
WHERE customer_id = 'clearwell' AND ts >= date_trunc('month', now());
```

sam_ops: runbook checklist items I'm adding: owner, dashboard link, scheduled export, notification template for customer, triage steps, who signs off on credits. Assigning owners: runbook = sam_ops, dashboard + queries = leah_eng, report template = ben_pm, customer comms = nora_csm.

aisha_cs: can we include an appendix that shows historical monthly uptime for the last 6 months and any onboarding-related incidents? that helps reduce renewal friction.

leah_eng: yes. I'll add a small chart and the incident list filtered by tag:@onboarding.

ben_pm: nora — I'll put a draft one-pager in the shared folder and ping you for review by EOD tomorrow. link: https://console.redwood.com/shared/clearwell-slo-onepager (will replace with final once leah & sam add data)

nora_csm: perfect. also let's capture feedback from Clearwell's enablement call — asking for a quick how-to on handling large imports without spiking latency. can we add a short FAQ to the runbook?

leah_eng: yes — short checklist: stagger imports, use client-side retries with jitter, limit parallel workers, and enable prefix-based KV cache warming. I'll draft it.

sam_ops: final note: I'll schedule the weekly export job now and add an automated slack notification to #customer-reports channel with the CSV. deploy-bot will confirm job.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job "clearwell-slo-weekly-export" to run every Monday 03:00 UTC. Destination: s3://redwood-customer-exports/clearwell/weekly.csv. Job id: job_98321.

nora_csm: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. action items recap in thread: sam_ops runbook + export (3d), leah_eng dashboard + SQL (2d), ben_pm report draft (1d), nora to review & send to customer (after draft).
